records.issue_text: app/models/topic_embed.rb:22 — Imported feed HTML is stored using `raw_html`, bypassing sanitization in `Post#cook` and allowing scripts and event handlers to survive as stored XSS on the forum’s origin; sanitize imported HTML before storing or rendering it.
records.rationale: The diff confirms the mechanism: Post#cook returns raw when cook_method == raw_html, and TopicEmbed.import creates posts with raw imported HTML (from open(url).read via readability, with no sanitization) while embed/best.html.erb renders `<%= raw post.cooked %>`, storing/reflecting untrusted external HTML on the forum origin. This is a real stored XSS defect introduced by the diff.
